rounds.text: The market is currently overlooking a critical pivot in operational efficiency, as evidenced by the company’s ability to expand its operating margin to 6% in the TTM compared to 4% three years ago [E20]. This structural improvement in profitability is being validated by the market’s own reaction, where profit growth is now outpacing one-year price growth by a ratio of 8.11, signaling that the company is beginning to outperform expectations [E43]. While the current valuation appears high on a book value basis [E1], the recent shift toward margin expansion suggests that the business is successfully optimizing its core operations despite broader sales headwinds. Conceded: [E3], [E5], [E6], [E7], [E8], [E9], [E10], [E21], [E47]. The company is operating within a sector experiencing significant tailwinds of 17.2% sales growth, providing a substantial runway for a business that has already demonstrated an improved capacity to extract profit from its operations [E20], [E55]. This combination of rising margins and positive performance signals suggests that the current market capitalisation of ₹ 27.6 Cr may not fully reflect the company's evolving operational profile [E2], [E43].

The bull’s reliance on a TTM margin expansion [E20] ignores the most recent and relevant data, which shows a sharp reversal to a -3% operating margin in the June 2026 quarter [E21]. This recent collapse in profitability directly contradicts the narrative of structural improvement and suggests that any prior gains were transitory [E21]. While the bull points to a profit-to-price ratio [E43], this metric is rendered meaningless by the company’s catastrophic sales trajectory, which has worsened from a 2% growth rate over ten years to a -27% decline in the trailing twelve months [E7, E10]. Furthermore, the bull’s optimism regarding sector tailwinds [E55] highlights a massive competitive failure, as the company’s -1% five-year sales growth [E8, E47] stands in stark contrast to the 17.2% growth achieved by its peers [E55]. Conceded: [E20], [E43]. Paying a 99.29x price-to-book multiple [E1] for a business with a negative return on equity [E6] and no dividend yield [E3] is not supported by the evidence, especially when the stock is already struggling to maintain its value within its 52-week range [E4].

evidence.fact: Price-to-book is 99.29x (price ₹ 27.8 on a book value of ₹ 0.28).
The stock sits 21% of the way up its 52-week range (23 low to 45 high).
Compounded sales growth over 10 years is 2%.
Compounded sales growth over 5 years is -1%.
Compounded sales growth over 3 years is -11%.
Compounded sales growth over the trailing twelve months is -27%.
Operating margin is 6% in TTM against 4% three years earlier (+2 percentage points).
Quarterly operating margin is -3% in Jun 2026 against 2% in the year-ago quarter (-5 percentage points).
PRICE-LED — Recently, profit growth exceeds 1-year price growth by 64% (ratio 8.11), the company is starting to outperform expectations.
Flagged as a negative: The company has delivered a poor sales growth of -0.95% over past five years.
